**Microsoft FY2024 gross margin (fiscal year ended June 30, 2024)**

- Revenue: $245,122 million; Cost of revenue: $74,114 million [msft_10k_fy2024.txt]
- Gross margin (dollars) = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008 million**
- Gross margin (percentage) = 171,008 / 245,122 = **69.8%**

ANSWER: $171,008 million (approximately 69.8% of revenue) for fiscal year ended June 30, 2024
